name: OpenCode OAuth
tagline: OAuth device-flow for the optional provider type
description: OAuth device-flow wiring (server, client_id, verification base) for the optional provider type. Provides the oauth feature only. Install the opencode CLI extension alongside it for the provider type, headers, tools and client signature. Requests org-scoped device codes and keeps the organization id.
author: aurora
notes: Device code is requested with supports_org_scope, matching the reference client, so the login lands in the account's organization.
Token responses carrying org_id are stored; metadata falls back to the first organization by id only when the token names none.
Pairs with the opencode CLI extension for the provider type and client signature.
Review third-party extensions before installing them from a store.

ui.help: Wires device-flow OAuth for the optional provider type (org-scoped, as the reference client does). No headers or tools — combine with the opencode CLI extension.
